AMIT DINKAR MHATRE E-Mail: mhatreamit88@yahoo.com Mobile No: +91 9821162416

SUMMARY

Highly accomplished and results-oriented Senior Associate with 13 years of extensive FCA CASS (Client Assets Sourcebook) regulatory experience in Finance, Investment banking operations and asset and wealth management sectors.

Comprehensive knowledge of FCA and securities regulations pertaining to CASS, with a strong focus on FCA client money daily calculations, particularly within UK banking institutions.

Demonstrated expertise in designing, managing, and implementing internal control frameworks that meet the highest CASS standards.

Skilled in identifying and monitoring the resolution of daily client money calculations breaches while ensuring process flows remain effective and up-to-date.

Capable of providing support and ensuring the implementation of appropriate systems and controls to help the organization maintain compliance with FCA CASS calculations.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:

- Winner of the Golden Mouse Award for Best Performance of the Year in Security Awareness in May 2026. - Earned back-to-back nominations for the prestigious M&G Stars Award (2024 & 2025). - Recognized as the Icon of the Quarter for Q4 2024 at M&G Global Services. - Awarded with Star of the month in May 2024 in M&G Global Services. - Successfully trained 28 new team members in Atos Syntel.

Successfully saved 1.50 FTE jobs within the first six months of production at M&G Global Services.

United Kingdom (UK) visit:

Acquired functional knowledge on Client Entitlement Report (CER) at Brentwood, United Kingdom. From IFDS (International Financial Data Services) for the period of 2 Weeks. From 7th Feb,2016 to 20th Feb,2016.

SKILLS SET

Business Requirement Analysis  Preparing process Sop’s (ISEM)  Conducting shortfall breaks Analysis  Training & Development Skills

Daily client money calculation rules  Knowledge of MS-Office (Word/Excel/PPT)  Managing Internal controls  Strong Communication Skills

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

M&G Global Services, Mumbai, India. Senior Analyst – Finance CASS (Client Assets) June 2021 – August 2026.  Accountable for daily client money & stock reconciliations are completed accurately and timely, meeting relevant

CASS rule requirements of Custody CASS.

Evaluated and enhanced internal control frameworks, identifying process inefficiencies, control gaps, and risk exposures across client onboarding, trade processing and settlement confirmations, corporate action events, custody reconciliations, Mandates.

Developed risk-based process maps to analyse settlement and CASS-related risks, ensuring appropriate risk identification, mitigation strategies, and control effectiveness across end-to-end client asset processes.

Leading assurance reviews to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of operational risk controls, ensuring compliance with FCA and FRC requirements.

Supported systems and controls designed to maintain compliance with FCA CASS client money calculation and safeguarding requirements.

Reviewing internal controls frameworks of CASS and stock reconciliation, as well as overseeing key statements, CMAR, stock shortfall processes.

Worked closely with UK stakeholders on a day-to-day basis to resolve operational and control issues and support regulatory compliance.

 Ensuring breaks are followed up and resolved promptly.

 Creating/Reviewing process SOPs to make sure are up to date.

DST Worldwide Services India Private Limited, Mumbai, India Specialists Financial Services Operations July 2020 – June 2021.  Assigned work & getting quality work done from the team members.  Ensured completion of all daily tasks as per set deadlines through daily check lists.  Reviewed & approved daily client money calculations & balances to ensure firm is CASS compliant.  Conducted regular and ad hoc analysis to identify opportunities to improve performance within and across the

teams.

Prepared day-to-day treasury report on funding, liquidity, and maturity issues.  Provide month end packs to Asset management companies.

ATOS SYNTEL Private Limited, Mumbai, India Senior Associate - Finance Client Money Reporting & Control (CMRC) Nov 2016 – July 2020.  Managed distributed work and ensured consistent in delivery of quality results.  Driving timely completion of daily tasks through checklist-based tracking.  Reviewed & approved daily client money calculations & balances to ensure firm is CASS compliant.  Executed regular and ad hoc assessments to identify performance enhancement opportunities.  Prepared day-to-day stock breaks funding, liquidity, and maturity issues.  Compiling and evaluating financial reports.  Send monthly reports to asset managers.

ATOS SYNTEL Private Limited, Mumbai, India. Associate - Finance Client Money Reporting & Control (CMRC) Dec 2012 – Nov 2016.  To monitor the inflow & outflow of funds.   Coordinating and follow up with the Banks regarding various matters.  Preparing & analyzing financial reports.  Provide month end packs to the Asset Management companies.  Working in tight SLA’s (Service Level Agreement) and Various deadlines.

Settlement of trade's as per Contractual or Actual settlement agreements.

SUCCESSFUL MIGRATIONS

CASS (Client Asset) process in M&G Global Services.  Audit & Compliance team in ATOS SYNTEL Private Limited.  SDBS (Same Day Banking System) project in ATOS SYNTEL Private Limited.  Schroders, Invesco, Columbia Threadneedle Asset Management companies in ATOS SYNTEL Private Limited.

EDUCATION

2012 2010

Master of Commerce in Finance University of Mumbai, Mumbai, India. Bachelor of Commerce in Finance University of Mumbai, Mumbai, India.

External Certification

2016 Passed Investment Operations Certificate (Level-1) – CISI (Chartered Institute for securities &

Investment London in November 2016.

Technical Proficiency

Autorek  Sonata  FAST  FSU

Thin Frontier  Web Frontier  MS Office  AWD

PERSONAL DETAILS

Date of Birth: Address: Languages Known: LinkedIn Profile:

28/08/1988 Mhatre house, Mahim causeway Slope, Mahim West, Mumbai – 400 016. English, Hindi & Marathi. www.linkedin.com/in/amit-mhatre-893377154
